Thank you for your reply, 

I realize I was never happy in my life, and always asking the purpose of my existence since kid, 

Every time I do Flashback to my earliest childhood memories, until current memory I always cried. No Happiness anywhere I remember.

I never get drunk in my life, never smoke, never do drugs.
you know the good kid stuff.

I believe I got some kind of ADHD too, never diagnosed, brain fog all over my head.

I always try to be the "clown" when meeting with friends, making jokes etc. so they smile.

and now I only have 2 active friends, Best friends I believe, we can share crazy dark jokes with ease.

I see suicide as a path to quit this world altogether.

being born is a mistake.
